scientific_integrity: Exact finite-dimensional proof with public reproducibility code. The isolated trimer threshold and generic degeneracy mechanism are credited as prior work. Novelty is limited to a quantitative, explicitly specified weighted bipartite family; independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite linear complex-symmetric weighted complete bipartite networks only
Uniform hopping within vertex classes and one balanced gain-loss pair
No disorder, generic lattice geometry, nonlinear effects, or large-network joint scaling
Originality subject to broader earlier spectral theorems and independent review
title: Exact singular gain–loss growth on weighted complete bipartite networks
